sources.title: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct: 32B Multilingual LLM for Enterprise Chat, Code ...
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct is a 32.7 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released September 2024. It supports up to 131K token context windows with 8K generation capacity, multilingual support (29+ languages), and improved performance on coding, mathematics, JSON generation, and long-form text.
